correctness.rationale: For all nonempty binary words with r ones and arbitrary nonnegative gaps, the proof covers zero starts, an exact order isomorphism on one-started suffixes including the terminal-gap corner case, the expanded LCE and the cited NGS/border identity. Suffix rank/monotone stack and LCP range-minimum construction establishes O((r+1)log(r+2)) word operations and O(r+1) words. The standalone code from actual package paths passed 27,304 exhaustive gap tuples, 1,500 independent oracle comparisons and five large compressed structural tests; finite checks only corroborate the general proof.

value.rationale: The object is the complete newly introduced inverse Lyndon array. The theorem computes a queryable representation of every entry in preprocessing proportional to sparse marker count rather than expanded length, exploiting a substantive terminal-aware suffix-order reduction and compressed border corrections. This is relevant for texts with huge zero runs and does not simply rename an ordinary Lyndon factorization or re-run the O(n) algorithm.
